description.value: Humble Roots Cafe & Deli is a farm-to-table cafe set in a restored rustic building on the rural fringe of Maple Ridge, surrounded by horses, farms, and views of Golden Ears. The kitchen works with seasonal and locally sourced ingredients, turning out handcrafted breakfasts, lunches, and deli fare with vegan and gluten-free options on the menu. Its scenic country setting and proximity to the Golden Ears corridor make it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the eastern Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active cafe and deli at 13179 224 St, Maple Ridge, BC, matching OSM address and phone number. Takeout and delivery are explicitly promoted on the homepage ('Order online for take-out, or curb-side pickup!'), and vegan and gluten-free options are confirmed through staff replies in the comments section. No bike-specific amenities (racks, charging, pump, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or derivable from OSM tags beyond outdoor_seating=yes, which does not constitute bike parking evidence.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Humble Roots' but the website consistently uses 'Humble Roots Cafe & Deli' as the full trading name.
Website comments span 2018–2021; most recent engagement visible is 2021, so currency of content is uncertain though the site remains live and functional.
No bike-specific amenities (rack, parking, pump, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website; these remain unverifiable without an on-site visit.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, food-focused cafe and deli in a scenic rural setting near Golden Ears with confirmed takeout and dietary options — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists in the Maple Ridge area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Staff confirmed in comments: 'We do have vegan options. We have a vegan soup daily, sandwich and wrap options plus home-made vegan sausages, falafel, baked beans.' Also confirmed gluten-free bread and 'a wide selection of other gluten free options.'

wow_evidence: farm-to-table cafe set in a restored rustic building...surrounded by horses, farms, and views of Golden Ears
